preparation: Single-molecule measurements with purified E. coli RNA polymerase and a DNA reporter in vitro.

retention.denominator: Molecules with visible labelled core polymerase when the sense RNA probe arrived, pooled across two experiments.
retention.observable: Polymerase signal still at the DNA spot more than four seconds after the sense transcript probe left.

secondary_transcription.observable: Antisense transcript probe appeared at the same spot in separate recordings, grouped by polymerase motion toward the promoter.

interpretation: RNA departure, persistence of polymerase on DNA, and synthesis of another RNA can be distinguished. The secondary-transcription denominators are separate motion-selected groups. The experiment gives no time for return to a well-mixed free polymerase pool.
